context: A boss and his manager discuss city planning issues
purpose: Teach: 支障/通行/務める/打ち出し/最善/適度/応える/相次い

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 再開発で、通行止めが業務に支障を来している。
lines.en: The redevelopment closures are creating serious disruptions to our operations.
lines.style: Calm, measured opening. Even tempo. Authority that doesn't need volume. Eyes on the problem, not the people. Slight pause between phrases.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。物流担当を務める部署と、対応を相次いで打ち出しています。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're coordinating with the logistics division and rolling out responses as we go.
lines.style: Professional acknowledgment without defensiveness. Steady cadence, showing competence through tone. Respectful but not deferential. Brief eye contact, then back to the work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 適度な迂回路を市に求める。最善策を取らせろ。
lines.en: Push the city to provide reasonable alternate routes. Make sure they implement the best options.
lines.style: Directive, not harsh. Clipped sentences with intention behind each. Matter-of-fact — this is what happens next. No room for hesitation, but not unkind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 要望書、明朝に応えると役所から連絡が来ました。
lines.en: The city's office just confirmed they'll respond to our formal request by tomorrow morning.
lines.style: Factual, concise. Light uplift at the confirmation — progress is moving. Lean forward slightly. No flourish, just the information.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Affirmation and closure. Brisk, final. Nod or small gesture of dismissal. Tone says 'case understood, execute'.
